messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@finbridge.com>, Samir Khan <samir.k@finbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 May 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: FinBridge renewal + capacity increase — MSA & order form redlines

Hi Ellen / Samir,

Thanks again for the productive renewal call last week. Per our notes: FinBridge is planning to renew the Redwood subscription for another 12 months starting 2028-07-01 and increase committed capacity by ~40% across the Dedicated pool.

I'm attaching our current MSA and the draft order form with the proposed capacity tiers. Two operational asks up front:
- Can your legal team send redlines on the MSA by next Friday (2028-06-04)?
- We need procurement confirmation on invoicing cadence (monthly vs. quarterly) so we can update billing and migration timelines.

Key business priorities we agreed on: SLA 99.9% for production endpoints, a temporary pilot of burst capacity during onboarding (first 30 days), and a one-time onboarding credit applied to July invoice. If you prefer, we can schedule a 30-minute sync between our legal and procurement leads to walk through items flagged as material.

Attachments (for reference): Redwood_MSA_2027_v2.docx, OrderForm_FinBridge_2027.pdf

Next steps: once we get redlines, Lauren will propose compromise language and Ben will lock the commercial terms.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out quickly.

—
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0189

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@finbridge.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.k@finbridge.com>, FinBridge Legal <legal@finbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 31 May 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinBridge renewal + capacity increase — MSA & order form redlines

Marcus —

Thanks for the summary. Our counsel reviewed the MSA and order form and we have a few material edits. I attached a redlined MSA (FinBridge_MSA_v3_redline.docx) and a marked-up order form PDF. High level:

1) Data retention / deletion (Section 4.2): we need a clearer timeline for data deletion and a guarantee that any customer-derived data kept for caching will be scoped to the agreed retention window.
2) Indemnity / liability cap (Section 8): FinBridge requires a higher cap for IP infringement claims when customer data is involved; we proposed a carve-out.
3) Termination notice / wind-down (Section 10): we asked for 60 days notice for capacity migration to avoid service disruption.
4) Billing proration / credits: please confirm how the one-time onboarding credit will be applied and whether prorated capacity charges are supported mid-term.

We flagged these as negotiable but want written responses and proposed language from your legal team before we enter a signature path. Happy to jump on a call next week if that helps.

Ellen Park
Head of Platform Ops, FinBridge Analytics
ellen.park@finbridge.com

Attachment: FinBridge_MSA_v3_redline.docx

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@finbridge.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 02 Jun 2028 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: FinBridge renewal + capacity increase — MSA & order form redlines

Ellen —

Thanks for the thorough pass and the redlines. I reviewed FinBridge_MSA_v3_redline.docx and pulled together proposed compromise language on the three main items you flagged. Summary below and attached is a tracked-changes file with the exact wording (Redwood_response_MSA_comments.docx):

1) Data retention / deletion (Section 4.2)
- Proposed compromise: Redwood will implement deletion of customer-derived data for caching within 30 days of request, except for anonymized telemetry retained for platform improvement. We will add a short exhibit describing retention windows by data type.

2) Indemnity / liability cap (Section 8)
- Proposed compromise: maintain the general liability cap but include an explicit narrow carve-out for proven third-party IP infringement arising solely from FinBridge-provided content. We will propose a sub-cap equal to the greater of the fees paid in 12 months or $500k.

3) Termination notice / wind-down (Section 10)
- Proposed compromise: agree to 60 days notice for planned migrations that require capacity transfers. For urgent termination for cause, the standard 30 days applies. We'll add an operational runbook exhibit that specifies handoff steps and support windows.

4) Billing proration / onboarding credit
- Redwood is prepared to apply a one-time onboarding credit netted on the first invoice after go-live. For mid-term capacity increases, we support prorated billing for the month of change. We'll add explicit invoicing examples to the order form so procurement can validate.

If FinBridge is comfortable with the above, we can prepare a final countersigned MSA and upload to DocuSign. I'm copying Ben so he can confirm commercial items (credits, start date, capacity tiers).

Thanks — happy to take any follow-up edits.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood_response_MSA_comments.docx

Ellen / Samir —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and Lauren for the clear compromise language. Commercial confirmation from our side:
- Start date: 2028-07-01 (we will reserve the committed Dedicated capacity by then).
- Capacity: +40% committed capacity as described in the attached order form; burst pool available first 30 days.
- Onboarding credit: $18,000 applied to first invoice post go-live.
- Invoice cadence: monthly by default; we can do quarterly billing if that is required — please confirm procurement preference.

Lauren, can you prepare the final clean MSA + order form reflecting the agreed edits and route to DocuSign? Ellen, once we have your countersign, we'll schedule the onboarding window (target week of 2028-07-01) and coordinate the capacity reserve.

If procurement wants quarterly billing, Marcus will follow up with an updated invoice schedule; otherwise we will proceed with monthly.
